text:
Mia Chen: FYI — AscentAI flagged a huge usage spike on INV-2026-0319-4559. Their normal monthly token ~400k; this invoice shows ~3.2M. They've requested a one-time courtesy credit while we investigate.
Aj Patel: Can you paste sample logs? Suspect client retry loop or double-counting on our meter.
Mia Chen: Pasted logs in thread, but here's the billing snapshot they sent: https://redwood.app/partners/ascentai/invoices/INV-2026-0319-4559. Invoice total: $18,750. Customer says they rolled back a bad deployment at 09:12 UTC.
Tariq Khan: ran quick query, looks like duplicate ingestion records for same request_id across retries. SQL:
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) as hits, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM prod.billing_events
WHERE partner_id = 'ascentai' AND event_time >= '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING hits > 1
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC;
```
Tariq Khan: sample: request_id=4f2b9a had hits=3 and tokens=45000 -> counted 3x.
Aj Patel: ok bug on client side + our idempotency not matching. We should credit the duplicated tokens only.
Nina Gomez: How much is duplicate? need exact credit amount + GL code. Also need manager approval for >$10k.
Aj Patel: Deduped tokens sum -> 1,500,000 tokens. Using our pricing that's $0.0125/token -> $18,750. (rounded)
Nina Gomez: That's >$10k. @Sasha Li please approve a goodwill/manual credit.
Sasha Li: I approve a one-time goodwill credit of $18,750, note: mark as 'courtesy — metering dupe' in memo and add flag 'do-not-auto-refund' so we can reconcile. Also add customer-facing note explaining root cause and mitigation.
billing-bot: New credit request created: CR-2026-0821 | amount: $18,750 | status: pending-AR
Mia Chen: AR — please issue credit memo against INV-2026-0319-4559 and confirm reversed balance. Also ensure partner gets a support postmortem link.
AR-Team: Copy — will create CM-INV-2026-0319-4559-CR20260821, apply to invoice, and issue credit memo today. Which refund path? credit memo preferred; refund to card only on request.
Mia Chen: credit memo is fine. Please cc sasha and me when done.
Tariq Khan: follow-up: I'll drop a patch to add server-side idempotency key verification and add a short-term mitigation to coalesce events within 2s window.
Aj Patel: after patch, deploy window? can we canary tomorrow morning.
Sasha Li: approved. Please include a note in the console release notes and ops runbook.
Mia Chen: thanks team — I'll send customer confirmation and timeline. Closing when AR posts CM ID.
AR-Team: CM created: CM-2026-0319-0007 applied. Invoice balance now zero. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
